intro: Dub Electric Experience is a DJ collective and event production company: dub plates, beats, and a sound system we built ourselves.
story: Founded in 2015 by Chris and Gregg, with Redman Chin joining as co-owner in 2018. In 2021 we built our own sound system because the bass has to be real. That rig grew into a full production operation: pro audio, LED walls, and lighting for weddings, corporate events, festivals, and the dances we came up in. Ten years on, the mission hasn't moved: quality first, always.

milestones.text: Founded in NYC by Chris and Gregg
Full production: sound, LED walls & lighting, East Coast to worldwide
